report_no_data: No monitoring data for this month
report_carried: Includes {duration} of an outage that started last month
report_gaps_sub: Time with no checks is never counted as an outage or as uptime.
report_gaps_explain: These are periods when this computer was off or asleep, or the app was closed. For the strongest evidence, run Internet Monitor on a computer that stays on, plugged in by cable to the router.
report_gap_off: Computer off, asleep or app closed
report_gap_power: Likely power cut (the router was still restarting when monitoring resumed)
report_after_gap: Right after monitoring resumed: may be the router restarting, not the provider
report_add_profile: Add your provider and plan to this report
report_evidence_hint: ZIP with this report, the raw logs and SHA-256 checksums
route_reached: Route: the internet was reachable, so the fault was in name lookup or the website check
route_none: Route: nothing answered, not even your router. Check the router, its power and the cable
route_router: Route: your router ({addr}) answered, but nothing beyond it, so the break was at the provider
route_stopped: Route: stopped after hop {hop} ({addr}) inside the provider's network
